chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Samaanah, who said:
I asked him about the Mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer): Does he speak while he is calling the Adhan? He said, 'There is no harm in it when he finishes his Adhan.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no harm / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for the Mu'adhdhin to speak while calling the Adhan?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the legal status of the Mu'adhdhin’s speech during the call to prayer, distinguishing between the act of calling itself and the immediate aftermath. It establishes that the prohibition of casual conversation applies strictly to the duration of the Adhan, permitting speech only after the recitation is fully concluded, thereby preserving the sanctity and focus of the ritual call.
